topic.summary: Renting against buying the same flat over 20 years: rent rises, EMI, down payment, maintenance, property tax, and what the saved difference becomes if it is kept aside. When buying wins, when renting wins, and the questions a family should ask before deciding.
topic.title: Kiraye par rahein ya ghar khareedein: 20 saal ka poora hisaab
